prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1301; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: Understood. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car.
Q: Where were you when the accident happened?
A: I was on the main road in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward the freeway. I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane to get ready for my exit.
Q: What did you do before changing lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I signaled and started to move over.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until it was already there. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed a little. The other car was right alongside me in the lane I was moving into.
Q: Had you been in contact with the other driver before the collision?
A: No. We didn't speak at the scene for very long. The other driver seemed shaken up but said he'd been in a hurry.
Q: Did your vehicle come to a stop after the impact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. I stayed in the car for a minute because my neck and right shoulder hurt right away.
Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: My right shoulder is sore and I have stiffness in my neck. I haven't had an official diagnosis yet, but I've been using ice and taking over-the-counter pain relief.
Q: Have you sought any medical treatment since the accident?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and I have a follow-up appointment scheduled.
Q: Is there anything else you think is important for us to know?
A: I just want to make sure my side of things is on record. I was signaling and checking before I moved over.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
